items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Frankie Dueson, I guess you might have heard talk of Frankie Dueson, the trombone player. Yeah. Well they used to play up on the roof garden.

ctx.x: Capri Dairnsberg, yeah. He used to play with Manuel Perez, him and uh, Frankie Dueson, I guess you might have heard talk of Frankie Dueson, the trombone player. Yeah. Well they used to play up on the roof garden. Well that's uh, that's the first, Captain was the first one I ever heard play a take solos. Well he used to be a mandolin player. Uh huh. And he uh, stopped playing mandolin and stopped playing banjo. Yeah? Yeah, I got a record with him playing mandolin. Yeah? With a blues singer. Yeah. You know he went…
